annotations.title: How a train has run recently

description: How one timetabled train has actually run over recent days, by its planning ID (from find_train, station_departures or get_train): each day's delay at its final destination, cancellations and any reason given, plus the share on time. Delay is measured where the train ends, not at any station along the way. History follows the planning ID, which changes when the timetable changes, so a newly timetabled train has little history; days the train did not run are simply absent.

days.description: How many days back to look, 1-60.
